Batch Error Continuation Option
elements.source_comment: If omitted, then Stop is assumed

elements.name: Batch Order Option
elements.source_comment: If omitted, then True is assumed

elements.name: Ephemeral
elements.source_comment: Indicates that the Data output of the operation should not be returned to the client. Boolean.

elements.name: Request Payload
elements.source_comment: Structure, contents depend on the Operation

elements.name: Attestation Type
elements.source_comment: REQUIRED in Attestation Required error message if client set Attestation Capable Indicator to True in the request

elements.name: Server Hashed Password
elements.source_requiredness: Yes, if Hashed Password credential was used
elements.source_comment: Hash(Timestamp || S1 || Hash(S2)), where S1, S2 and the Hash algorithm are defined in the Hashed Password credential.

elements.name: Asynchronous Correlation Value
elements.source_comment: REQUIRED if Result Status is Pending

elements.name: Operation
elements.source_requiredness: Yes, if specified in Request Batch Item

elements.name: Response Payload
elements.source_comment: Structure, contents depend on the Operation

elements.name: Result Message
elements.source_comment: OPTIONAL if Result Status is not Pending or Success

elements.name: Result Reason
elements.source_requiredness: Yes, if Result Status is Failure
elements.source_comment: REQUIRED if Result Status is Failure, otherwise OPTIONAL

elements.name: Unique Batch Item ID
elements.source_comment: REQUIRED if present in Request Batch Item

elements.name: Vendor Identification
elements.source_encoding: Text String (with usage limited to alphanumeric, underscore and period – i.e. [A-Za-z0-9_.])

elements.name: Discover Versions
elements.scope_reason: Server-initiated operation support is scheduled for KMIPKit 1.1.

elements.scope_reason: Server-initiated operation support is scheduled for KMIPKit 1.1.

elements.name: Put
elements.scope_reason: Server-initiated operation support is scheduled for KMIPKit 1.1.

elements.name: Query
elements.scope_reason: Server-initiated operation support is scheduled for KMIPKit 1.1.

elements.name: Set Endpoint Role
elements.scope_reason: Server-initiated operation support is scheduled for KMIPKit 1.1.

elements.name: IV Length
elements.source_requiredness: No unless Block Cipher Mode supports variable IV lengths

elements.name: P Source
elements.source_requiredness: No (if omitted, defaults to an empty byte string for encoding input P in OAEP padding)

elements.name: Salt Length
elements.source_requiredness: No (if omitted, defaults to the block size of the Mask Generator Hashing Algorithm)

elements.name: Tag Length
elements.source_requiredness: No unless Block Cipher Mode is GCM

elements.name: Trailer Field
elements.source_requiredness: No (if omitted, defaults to the standard one-byte trailer in PSS padding)

elements.name: Digest Value
elements.source_requiredness: Yes, if the server has access to the Digest Value or the Key Material (for keys and secret data), the Certificate Value (for certificates) or the Opaque Data Value (for opaque objects).

elements.name: Key Format Type
elements.source_requiredness: Yes, if the Managed Object is a key or secret data object.

elements.name: Attribute Value
elements.source_requiredness: Yes, except for the Notify operation

elements.name: Vendor Identification
elements.source_encoding: Text String (with usage limited to alphanumeric, underscore and period – i.e. [A-Za-z0-9_.])

elements.name: Subject Alternative Name
elements.source_requiredness: Yes, if the Subject Distinguished Name is an empty string.

elements.name: Subject Distinguished Name
elements.source_requiredness: Yes, but MAY be the empty string

elements.name: Vendor Identification
elements.source_encoding: Text String (with usage limited to alphanumeric, underscore and period – i.e. [A-Za-z0-9_.])

elements.name: Derivation Data
elements.source_requiredness: Yes, unless the Unique Identifier of a Secret Data object is provided. May be repeated.

elements.name: Initialization Vector
elements.source_requiredness: No, depends on the PRF (if different than those defined in [PKCS#5]) and mode of operation: an empty IV is assumed if not provided.

elements.name: Iteration Count
elements.source_requiredness: Yes if Derivation method is PBKDF2.

elements.name: Salt
elements.source_requiredness: Yes if Derivation method is PBKDF2.

elements.name: Encoding Option
elements.source_requiredness: No. If Encoding Option is not present, the wrapped Key Value SHALL be TTLV encoded.

elements.name: Encryption Key Information
elements.source_requiredness: No, SHALL be present if MAC/Signature Key Information is omitted

elements.name: MAC/Signature Key Information
elements.source_requiredness: No, SHALL be present if Encryption Key Information is omitted
